correctness.rationale: The standard sufficiently subdivided unordered two-particle wheel cubical model has c0=choose(n+1,2), c1=2n(n-1), c2=n(3n-7)/2. A 2-cycle has zero coefficients on spoke-containing squares by path link deletion, then zero on rim-only squares by another path deletion, so H2=0 and H1 has rank n+1. For each dihedral element the signed fixed-cell Lefschetz trace gives χ=1-t0+t1-t2; orientation reversals and exchanged square factors yield the stated rotation/reflection cases. Character orthogonality gives 2 sign lines plus nontrivial two-dimensional representations (and rotation-sign when n even), and finite-group rational transfer gives quotient statements. Independently enumerated all oriented fixed 0/1/2-cells for every dihedral element at n=4..14, exactly reproducing the claimed character; a finite check is not the all-n proof.
